sources.title: Afghanistan — About the Journal
sources.note: Official Edinburgh University Press scope read through a text cache after direct access returned HTTP 403. It places Afghanistan Studies at the overlap of Near Eastern, Central Asian and South Asian studies and emphasizes interconnected pre-modern histories and cultures. These are stated study areas, not the publisher location.

sources.title: Africa Review — Instructions for Authors
sources.note: Official Brill instructions PDF read directly. The scope covers historical and other social-science and humanities enquiries concerning African affairs, individual African countries and comparative regional developments.

sources.title: African and Asian Studies — Instructions for Authors
sources.note: Official Brill instructions PDF read directly. The scope publishes social-science research on individuals and societies in Africa and Asia, their cultures and relationships, including comparative work.

sources.title: African Studies — Aims and scope
sources.note: Official Taylor & Francis aims and scope read through a text cache after direct access returned HTTP 403. It is an interdisciplinary journal for conceptual and empirical research relevant to Africa, explicitly including anthropology and history among its disciplines.

sources.title: Akkadica — About
sources.note: Official Ghent University journal page read directly. It welcomes research on the archaeology, history and languages of Western Asia.

sources.title: Altorientalische Forschungen — Journal overview
sources.note: Official De Gruyter page read directly. It publishes history and culture of the Ancient Near East and exchanges with Central Asia, Egypt and the Aegean, welcoming philological, archaeological and art-historical work.

sources.title: Anatolian Studies — About this journal
sources.note: Official Cambridge journal page read directly. Its scope focuses on Türkiye and the Black Sea littoral in history, archaeology, cultural heritage and related disciplines.

sources.title: Anatolica — Peeters Online Journals
sources.note: Official publisher journal page read directly. It welcomes history and archaeology of Anatolia and adjacent regions from prehistory through the Ottoman era.

sources.title: Ancient Asia — DOAJ journal record
sources.note: DOAJ API record read directly. It assigns LCC subjects History of Asia, Archaeology and Architecture and supplies archaeology, history, anthropology, art, architecture and numismatics as journal keywords.
